{{Top|leg}}
'''Norax''' was a type of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that could be used for industrial purposes. There were deposits of it on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Gaftikar]] and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This was one of the reasons why [[Shenio Mining]] pressured the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into [[Battle of Gaftikar|capturing]] Gaftikar from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].
